mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (student_name, furigana, nickname, email, city, age, gender, remark, is_deleted) VALUES (#{studentName}, #{furigana}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{city}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{remark}, false)
INSERT INTO students_courses (student_id, course_name, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET student_name = #{studentName}, furigana = #{furigana}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, city = #{city}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
